run_download_file_group: run the download_file_group function to download a specified group of large files from S3
run_download_all_files: run the CLI script to download all file groups by passing the ALL argument
run_download_adsorbml_files: run the CLI script to download only the adsorbml file group for AdsorbML data
review_change_path_for_pypi: review the change_path_for_pypi function that modifies file paths for PyPi-installed builds
review_fairchem_root: review the fairchem_root function that returns the root directory of the installed fairchem-core package
